simple.meaning: שָׁנֶה (shâneh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a year (as a revolution of time).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 880 times across Genesis, beginning at Genesis 1:14. Its contexts include family, family line, death.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁנֶה (H8141).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
